unlisted_practices: Refrain from drawing conclusions about systemic effects of AI from single studies.
Distinguish the benefits of AI explicitly in terms of effectiveness (getting more done) and efficiency (doing it with fewer resources) in future research.
Conduct more research on the relation between trust and efficiency in medical AI, including how trust emerges and whether expectations of efficiency cause unwarranted trust and overreliance.
Account for the full human labor of developing, validating, maintaining, annotating, and supporting medical AI when assessing its workload and efficiency impact.
Continue to critically assess whether emerging AI systems fulfill the needs of clinical realities.

screen.reason: This is a viewpoint/commentary discussing why accuracy should not be conflated with efficiency in medical AI implementations, focusing on human workload, implementation factors, and governance.
